title: Tampa Bay Lighting Fan Slaps The Taste Out Of Man's Mouth, But Wife Retaliates With Haymakers [Watch]
htmlContent:
A couple of Tampa Bay Lighting fans got an argument that led to one of the fans flipping the bird to a couple behind the glass board.

The fan that flipped the couple the bird elected to leave his seat and slap the taste out of the dude mouth in front of his wife, resulting in the couple retaliating and the wife throwing haymakers as Cuff The Legend narrating in the background.

Speaking of the Tampa Bay Lighting, they recently closed out a six-game homestand against a Blue Jackets, who correctly have the fewest points in the Eastern Conference. The Lighting started off slow at the beginning of the game, but were able to find their groove in the third period against Columbus  that is plagued by injuries this season. They were able to pull away to secure a 4-1 victory.

Brayden Point gave the Lighting the lead just over nine minutes into his third.
Brandon Hagel found the bottom of the net twice after that, and Nikita Kucherov attended on the three goals.

After the game, Lighting coach Jon Cooper was asked about the homestand.

“I like the way the guys have done it on this,” said, Copper according to Yahoo. " Going into the third periods, we’ve had leads and we’ve been tied and we’ve pushed in that period like we did (Thursday), and points are following. So it was a good homestand, and on the defensive side of things we’ve gotten much better as things went on.”
